 "body": "### Motivation\n- Implement the bounded generic foundation packet for #760 using the finite-game,\n  tensor-product-strategy, symmetric-strategy, and SPCC definitions in\n  `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex`.\n- Give the eventual Mathlib-only Palomar challenge an exact, compact statement\n  surface without changing the existing QPBT game API.\n\n### Description\n- Add a 134-line Mathlib-only public module defining PMF games, POVMs, unit pure\n  strategies, symmetric games and strategies, Born value, projectivity,\n  consistency, support-wise commutation, and SPCC.\n- Add exact conversions between the compact structures and the existing library\n  structures, including structural round trips where representations coincide,\n  equality of induced question PMFs and Born values, and equivalences for\n  projectivity, consistency, support-wise commutation, and SPCC.\n- Keep the proof bridge separate from the challenge foundation. The bridge uses\n  legacy imports because Lean module files cannot import the current non-module\n  `Games.StrategyClasses` API; the foundation itself uses `module`,\n  `public import`, and `@[expose] public section`.\n- Leave existing declarations and root imports unchanged.\n\n### Statement integrity\n- Paper assumptions: finite question and answer alphabets, a probability\n  distribution, finite-dimensional unit pure states, POVMs, swap invariance,\n  and commutation on positive-probability question pairs.\n- Lean assumptions: the corresponding `Fintype` and `DecidableEq` boundary\n  instances, with probabilities represented by `PMF`.\n- Paper and Lean conclusions agree exactly. Converting an existing\n  `Distribution` through `PMF` canonicalizes its stored support to `univ`, so\n  exactness is expressed by equality of the induced PMF and game value; the\n  compact round trip is structural equality.\n\n### Bound strength\n- All added bridge results are exact equalities or logical equivalences. No\n  quantitative estimate or weakening is introduced.\n\n### Testing\n- `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Palomar/Foundation.lean`\n- `rg -n \"sorry|axiom\" MIPStarRE/QPBT/Palomar/Foundation.lean` (no output)\n- `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Palomar/Bridge.lean`\n- `rg -n \"sorry|axiom\" MIPStarRE/QPBT/Palomar/Bridge.lean` (no output)\n- `lake build MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Bridge`\n- `scripts/install_git_hooks.sh --check`\n- Normal pre-commit statement-integrity, proof-debt, anti-pattern, and axiom\n  hooks passed for all three commits.\n\n---\nCloses #760\n",

item.text: PR #761 is open at the pushed head `517b0b60`, carries both requested labels, and closes #760. The worktree is clean; I’m taking the final elapsed-time measurement for the session report.

## What changed
Added [Foundation.lean](/home/drx/MIPStarRE-qpbt/.worktrees/issue-760-palomar-strategy-equivalences/MIPStarRE/QPBT/Palomar/Foundation.lean), a 134-line Mathlib-only public module defining finite games, POVMs, strategies, symmetry, Born value, consistency, projectivity, commutation, and SPCC.

Added [Bridge.lean](/home/drx/MIPStarRE-qpbt/.worktrees/issue-760-palomar-strategy-equivalences/MIPStarRE/QPBT/Palomar/Bridge.lean) with exact conversions, round trips, value equalities, and predicate equivalences.

Published [PR #761](https://github.com/Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-QPBT/pull/761) from three hook-checked commits. Cumulative session time: `00:24:12`.

## Evidence
- Both files pass `lake env lean`.
- Both `sorry|axiom` scans return no output.
- `lake build MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Bridge` succeeded.
- Hook installation check and all pre-commit integrity hooks passed.
- Remote branch matches `517b0b60`.
- Full `lake build` was intentionally skipped per the issue contract; MAIN owns canonical CI.

## Statement integrity
Paper assumptions: finite carriers, probability distribution, finite-dimensional unit pure state, POVMs, swap invariance, and positive-support commutation.

Lean assumptions: corresponding `Fintype` and `DecidableEq` boundary instances, with probabilities represented by `PMF`.

Paper and Lean conclusions: exact value and predicate semantics.

Verdict: faithful boundary hypotheses; no extra mathematical assumptions. No existing paper-labelled declaration changed.

## Bound strength
Stated results are exact equalities or equivalences. The proofs establish those same exact results.

Disposition: sharp, with no quantitative loss.

## Open obligations
None.

## Handoff
Review the PMF/`Distribution` support equivalences and value-preservation proofs first. The bridge uses legacy imports because the existing game API is not yet a Lean `module`; the compact foundation itself has the required public module surface. No further prover session is required.
